exits.how: Place the stop-loss and the target as two separate orders right after the entry fills. When one fills, cancel the other. Anything still open at the broker's square-off time is closed by the broker for a fee; be flat by 15:10. F&O stop is SL (stop-limit) with a limit buffer, because brokers restrict SL-M and market orders in options: if the price gaps past the limit, the stop does not fill.
